1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.

3. Through the present petition, the petitioner seeks grant of anticipatory bail in case FIR No.
511/2025 registered at Police Station Subzi Mandi for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(m) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
4. Issue notice.
Learned APP for State, who appears on advance notice, accepts notice and seeks some time to file status report.

5. Let the same be filed three days prior to the next date of hearing.
6.
